questiontext.text:
The content of three bags \({@ball_I_white@}, {@ball_I_red@}\) and \({@ball_I_black@}\) as follows

Balls White Black Red
Bag \(I\) \({@ball_I_white@}\) \({@ball_I_black@}\) \({@ball_I_red@}\)
Bag \(II\) \({@ball_2_white@}\) \({@ball_2_black@}\) \({@ball_2_red@}\)
Bag \(III\) \({@ball_3_white@}\) \({@ball_3_black@}\) \({@ball_3_red@}\)


Note: Give your answer as a fraction, or to \(2\) decimal places.

A bag is chosen at random and from it two balls are drawn at random. The two balls are found to be one white and one black. What is the probability that they are from the second bag?

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

Let \(B_1,B_2,B_3\) denote the events that the bags \(I, II\) and \(III\) are chosen respectively.

Let \(A\) be the event that the two balls taken from the selected bag are white and black.

Then,

\(P(B_1)=P(B_2)=P(B_3)=\displaystyle \frac{1}{3}\)

Then \(P(A|B_1)=\displaystyle\frac {^{@ball_I_white@}C_1 \times ^{@ball_I_black@}C_1}{^{@is_sum@}C_2}={@p_a_b1@}\):
We get \(^{@ball_I_white@}C_1 \times ^{@ball_I_black@}C_1\) because there are \({@ball_I_white@}\) white balls in bag \(I\) to choose \(1\) ball from for \(^{@ball_I_white@}C_1\) choices to achieve that, and \({@ball_I_black@}\) black balls in bag \(I\) to choose \(1\) from for \(^{@ball_I_black@}C_1\) choices to achieve that, out of a total of \(^{@is_sum@}C_2\) choices to choose 2 balls.

The same procedure is repeated for \(P(A|B_2)=\displaystyle\frac {^{@ball_2_white@}C_1 \times ^{@ball_2_black@}C_1}{^{@is_sum@}C_2}={@p_a_b2@}, P(A|B_3)=\displaystyle\frac {^{@ball_3_white@}C_1 \times ^{@ball_3_black@}C_1}{^{@is_sum@}C_2}={@p_a_b3@}\)


Finally, \(P(B_2|A)=\displaystyle\frac {P(B_2)P(A|B_2)}{\sum_{i=1}^{3} P(B_i)P(A|B_i)}=\displaystyle\frac {\displaystyle \frac{1}{3}\times {@p_a_b2@}}{(\displaystyle \frac{1}{3}\times {@p_a_b1@})+(\displaystyle \frac{1}{3}\times {@p_a_b2@})+(\displaystyle \frac{1}{3}\times {@p_a_b3@})}=\displaystyle{@p_b2_a@}\) or \({@sol1@}\) in float form
